author: daveeyyy_
name: Davey
text:
Yuval Noah Harari: AI could destroy humanity without killing a single human being.

"My biggest fear is that it's not a specific scenario like AI creating a virus or killer robots."

"It's really that in five or 10 or 20 years, all humans will just have no idea what is happening anymore."

"Our reality will just collapse. We won't understand finance, we won't understand politics, we won't understand science."

"There are still clouds and trees and cats, but the systems that control the world are way beyond our understanding."
